config.enabled: Let the editor take the season's colours. `false` removes everything this extension wrote at the next window start.
config.title: Also prefix `window.title` with the season's glyph, so it shows in the title bar and in the browser tab. The previous title is saved and restored.
config.events: Your own windows, checked **before** the six shipped ones, so an entry here shadows a default it overlaps. `from`/`to` are `MM-DD` and inclusive; `to` earlier than `from` crosses the year.
config.saved: Written by the extension, read by the extension: the values that were there before the current season, so they can be put back. Not for hand-editing — delete it only if you want the current colours to stay.
